title: arXiv 来源可靠性整改验收

source_policy.global_scope: single service process and artifact/cache root

cache.key: SHA-256 of normalized full arXiv request URL

source_abstraction.reason: Cross-source candidate and Evidence semantics require a separately frozen migration; no third-party response was relabeled as arXiv.

focused.command: uv run --frozen pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_paper_discovery.py tests/test_durable_paper_discovery.py tests/test_bounded_paper_strategy.py tests/test_bounded_paper_fault_matrix.py

full_regression.note: Windows pytest emitted a known atexit PermissionError while cleaning its temporary numbered directory after the successful test exit.

fault_matrix: 429 retry exhaustion with all attempt Artifacts retained
invalid Atom XML is not cached

acceptance.live_429_recovery: not_observed; validated by fixture fault matrix only
acceptance.new_five_task_reaudit: required and not authorized by this acceptance

remaining_risks: The governor is not a cross-process or distributed lock; the product remains one process/one Worker.
Hard HTTP 403 responses are not retried because repetition may worsen source blocking.
No OpenAlex, Crossref or other secondary source is connected to the durable Workbench path.
A fresh five-task audit is required; prior failed and partial W5.7 tasks cannot be recounted.
evidence_boundary: W5.7-R1 proves bounded arXiv request governance, persistent cache behavior, retained retry evidence and one source-only live normal/cache path. It does not prove that every future 429 will recover, cross-process coordination, cross-source retrieval, sustained personal-use success or release readiness.
